stem_book: A uniform chain of length 2 m is kept on a table such that a length of 60 cm hangs from the edge of the table. The total mass of the chain is 4 kg. What is the work done in pulling the entire chain on the table? (Take g = 10 m/s²) (a) 7.2 J (b) 3.6 J (c) 120 J (d) 1200 J
work: Hanging mass = 4·0.6/2 = 1.2 kg, CM 0.3 m below: W = 1.2·10·0.3 = 3.6 J
